title: ARC Raiders PvE matchmaking toggle test ends: 30M+ PvE rounds, 'polarizing', survey from 22 Oct, more in November

sources.name: Embark, 'PvE Matchmaking Toggle Test: Thanks for taking part!'
Embark Steam event 'PvE Toggle Beta Test: October 13-20'

claims.text: The limited-time PvE matchmaking toggle test (13 to 20 Oct) has ended
More than 30 million rounds of PvE were played over the test
Survey to a representative sample of players from 22 Oct

why: A huge live game tested dropping PvP and its players split; the outcome lands in November

media.kind: official trailer, full height; its own score with the narrator from 30 s; rendered on the GitHub runner

notes: Split past four today (dated: survey 22 Oct, details November; gap rule precedent 16 and 17 Oct; caps question open since 09:45Z). Grammar review: fixes applied (survey to a sample, not all players; يكشف for يشارك). DeepL forward offered آراء متباينة / انقسام المجتمع for polarizing; kept قسم آراء اللاعبين. Back-check matches. Variety: last ARC Raiders story 12 Oct.
